target_customer: NFT investors and traders who pay or generate fees for NFT analytics, later for trading on a marketplace
problem: NFT buyers could not tell which NFTs were worth buying; the founders measured community discussion on Twitter and Discord as a value signal, and later found traders researched on their tool but bought elsewhere.
business_model: NFT analytics tool with subscriptions or premium features, later planned marketplace commissions
product_category: NFT analytics, then NFT trading marketplace and aggregator (renamed Singular)

founders.name: Adam Zvada
education: FIT CTU (Czech Technical University in Prague), graduate, studied artificial intelligence
founders.background_notes: FIT CTU article (April 2022) says both founders worked at Avast and then ran Cognitic. CzechCrunch (Nov 2022) gave ages 29 and 27 as of that date; not recorded as age at founding.

founders.name: David Mokos
education: Studied artificial intelligence (school not named in the source)
founders.background_notes: YC page bio: former AI/ML engineer, now building steercode.com.

exit.reason: NFTScoring was wound down in November 2022 in favor of the Singular marketplace (CzechCrunch). A single third-party profile says Singular shut down in 2024 as NFT interest declined; no company announcement found.

competitors.name: Gem
competitors.funding_then: Not stated; acquired by OpenSea in April 2022

competitors.name: Genie
competitors.what: NFT marketplace aggregator launched January 2022, later bought by Uniswap

technical_complexity.rationale: Scoring NFTs from social and on-chain data and later aggregating marketplace liquidity is standard data and web3 engineering with some hard parts for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Analytics rested on public on-chain and social data, and aggregators and marketplaces could add the same views; the founders' own account says traders left to buy on other marketplaces.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenSea acquired Gem in April 2022 and Uniswap acquired Genie, absorbing the aggregator wedge; Blur launched in October 2022 as marketplace and aggregator and took trading volume.

market_need_then: In 2021 and early 2022 the NFT market was booming; the founders reported 500,000 users and over 400,000 dollars of revenue for NFTScoring by November 2022 (CzechCrunch), evidence of demand for NFT research tools.

branding.name_origin: NFTScoring is descriptive: scoring NFTs. The Singular name was chosen for the trading marketplace; the founders' reason for the name is not stated.
branding.domain_note: nftscoring.com, a descriptive exact name .com; site returned HTTP 503 on fetch.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Trader focused, pro trader positioning on the YC page

rebrands.why: Traders researched on NFTScoring and bought elsewhere, so the founders built a trader marketplace (CzechCrunch)

branding.community_and_virality: A Product Hunt listing for NFT Scoring existed before the rename; CzechCrunch and FIT CTU covered the founders and the funding rather than the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name with a Product Hunt listing and Czech press about the founders; the reported 500,000 users show reach but no source credits the brand itself, and the rename discarded it.

pivots.to: Singular, NFT trading marketplace and aggregator for traders
pivots.why: Users researched NFTs on NFTScoring but bought on other marketplaces, so the team wanted to keep the trades on its own platform

outcome_analysis: NFTScoring rode the 2021 NFT boom, raised about 1.7 million dollars pre-seed before and during YC Winter 2022, and reported 500 thousand users by late 2022. Traders used it to research but bought on other marketplaces, so the founders wound it down in November 2022 and pivoted to the Singular marketplace, entering a field where OpenSea and Uniswap had just bought the aggregators and Blur was launching. One third-party profile says Singular shut down in 2024 as NFT interest declined, which is unverified.
notes: Pre-seed amount of 1.7M (CZK 37M) is stated by CzechCrunch and FIT CTU in CZK; date of 2022-01 comes from VCBacked and CzechCrunch says announced early 2022. Investor list from CzechCrunch (FIT CTU article names none). Seedtable lists 1.68M and Employbl 2M; minor conflict. The 2024 Singular shutdown rests on a single third-party profile (via search snippet) and is unverified; exit date is therefore soft. OpenSea and LooksRare were named as competitors only in a November 2022 article, so they are not listed as 2022-01 competitors. Company site returned 503 on fetch.
